ValidationRule.description: Restricts the users to update the status as Sales Qualified and Converted if the Address if Blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), ISBLANK(Address), ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,'Sales Qualified'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Converted') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure that this lead has an Address prior to marking the Lead Status as Sales Qualified or Converted
